content_zh:
苏檀低着头，尽量降低存在感, 通过这两天的观察，她几乎可以肯定，封京墨并不知道那晚的人是她, 这样就好, 只要自己不做什么事惹他注意，俩人应该不会有太多交集。
就让那晚的秘密烂入她肚中。
“咖啡还是茶？”封京墨淡声问。
“不用了。”苏檀掏出手里的保温杯, 封京墨眉头轻挑, 漫不经心地扫了保温杯一眼, 却见几颗枸杞和几片红枣飘在水面, 下面还有一些不知名的养生食材, 也不知她是怎么做的，这养生茶香味很浓，清甜的香味甚至遮盖了咖啡香, 不停钻入他的鼻腔。
封京墨扫了眼杯中的清咖, 顿时有种败了的感觉。
哪怕是再好的茶饮，也被眼前保温杯中的枸杞打败了。
苏檀笑眯眯喝了养生茶，果然，年轻人就该养生！什么咖啡绿茶的，说起来那么多益处，事实上不是谁都适合的，今早她给自己把了脉，发现这具身体体质虚，气不足，阴气压过阳气，加上年轻人喜欢熬夜，身体亚健康，走几步就喘，昨天出一趟门回来累得不行，这都是身体不好的表现，因此，苏檀一早便调了养生茶，打算从今天起开始养气。
说实话，年轻人就该人手一个保温杯，好好爱自己！
于是，她和封京墨各怀心思地吃了面包。
她喝她的家常枸杞养生茶，他喝他高大上的清咖。
俩人全程一句话没有。
饭后，苏檀思考着下一步该怎么走。
开中医馆是肯定的，以她的医术，她不怕开不起来，眼前和封陵游的婚姻真是一本烂账，她恨不得马上离婚，搬出这个家，只是，原身执着了这么久，她就这样把原身一直在乎的东西给踹开，万一哪天原身回来，她怎么交代？再者，原身家仅存的药方都给了封家，现在好了，封陵游凭借药方翻身，在公司站住了脚，这时搞个小三就想把她一脚踹开，世界上哪有那么容易的事？
因此，她和封陵游的婚事，还要从长计议。
苏檀绕了一圈，发觉家里仅剩下几个佣人，她拉着一个年轻女生问了句，对方奇怪地看着她：
“今晚封家举行晚宴，庆祝四爷回来，你不知道？”
苏檀笑着摇头，她确实不知道，家里也没人跟她说。
讲真，她不爱去这种场合，可她还是封陵游的老婆，这全家人都瞒着她，要说没鬼她都不信。
苏檀赶紧回屋翻箱倒柜。
原身的衣帽间不算大，毕竟地位摆在这，男人没贴心到为她量身定制一个衣帽间，加上原身还是学生，里面很多休闲装，晚宴的场合肯定用不到，苏檀找了很久，没找到一件像样的衣服。

出去买？时间倒是来得及，只是这钱……
苏檀连忙上网查了银行卡，苏檀父母留下的存款办完他们的丧事后虽然有点剩余，可封家从不给她生活费，她一个学生，日常开销也不算小，两年书读下来，几张卡里的存款凑起来，也不过两千块，这点钱，哪够买礼服的？
苏檀想着对策，她翻了下手机，里面有几个原身的好友，苏檀挑出一个打电话过去，对方听完叹气道：“少奶奶，我哪知道哪里可以买礼服？要么你去名品店看看？”
“名品店在哪？”
“中央商场附近咯。”
苏檀挂了电话，坐在沙发上叹了口气，今天这衣服还真不好找了，要么晚宴就别去了吧！否则穿的太随便过去，只会适得其反。
谁知，苏檀电话刚挂，就见一个男人走过来，笑笑：
“苏小姐，我叫商陆，我们封总让我送您去做造型。”
“什么？”苏檀一怔，抬眼看去，落地窗外面，一辆黑色轿车，刚刚离开。
是听到她的电话了？还是不需要任何猜测都能判断出她的窘境？
苏檀勾了勾唇，没说话。
女士做造型要早一些，苏檀过去时，有好几个女士在做了，开门的是个打扮精致的男人，一身香水味，看起来有点娘，说话却叫人很舒服。
“苏小姐，我叫希瑞。”
苏檀笑着打招呼。

content_en:
Su Tan lowered her head and tried to reduce her presence as much as possible. After the past two days of observation, she was almost certain that Feng Jingmo didn't know that it was her that night. That was fine. As long as she didn't do anything to attract his attention, the two of them shouldn't have much interaction.
Let the secret of that night rot into her belly.
"Coffee or tea?" Feng Jingmo asked quietly.
"No need." Su Tan took out the thermos cup in his hand. Feng Jingmo raised his eyebrows and glanced at the thermos cup casually. He saw a few wolfberries and red dates floating on the water. There were also some unknown health ingredients below. I don't know how she made them. The health tea had a strong fragrance. The sweet fragrance even covered the coffee fragrance and kept getting into his nose.
Feng Jingmo glanced at the clear coffee in the cup and suddenly felt defeated.
No matter how good the tea was, it was defeated by the wolfberry in the thermos cup in front of me.
Su Tan smiled and drank the health tea. Sure enough, young people should maintain health! Coffee and green tea have so many benefits, but in fact they are not suitable for everyone. She took her own pulse this morning and found that her body was weak, with insufficient Qi, and the Yin Qi prevailed over the Yang Qi. In addition, young people like to stay up late, and are not in good health. They are out of breath after walking a few steps, and came back very tired from a trip yesterday. These are all signs of poor health. Therefore, Su Tan made health tea early in the morning and planned to start nourishing Qi from today.
To be honest, young people should have a thermos cup and love themselves!
So, she and Feng Jingmo ate the bread with their own thoughts.
She drinks her home-made wolfberry health tea, and he drinks his high-quality clear coffee.
The two of them didn't say a word the whole time.
After dinner, Su Tan thought about what to do next.
It is certain to open a traditional Chinese medicine clinic. With her medical skills, she is not afraid that she will not be able to open it. Her current marriage with Fenglingyou is really a mess. She wants to divorce immediately and move out of this house. However, the original person has been attached to it for so long, and she just kicked away the things that the original person has always cared about. What if the original person comes back one day, how will she explain it? Furthermore, all the remaining prescriptions from the original family were given to the Feng family. Now that they are fine, Fenglingyou has made a comeback with the prescriptions and has established a foothold in the company. At this time, a mistress wants to kick her away. How can anything in the world be so easy?
Therefore, her marriage to Fenglingyou needs to be considered in the long run.
Su Tan walked around and found that there were only a few servants left in the house. She asked a young girl, who looked at her strangely:
"The Feng family is holding a dinner tonight to celebrate the fourth master's return, didn't you know?"
Su Tan smiled and shook her head. She really didn't know, and no one at home told her.
To be honest, she didn't like to go to such occasions, but she was still Fenglingyou's wife, and the whole family kept this secret from her, and she didn't believe it was true.
Su Tan quickly went back to the house and rummaged through the cabinets.
The original cloakroom was not big. After all, given her status, the man was not considerate enough to tailor a cloakroom for her. In addition, she was still a student, so there were a lot of casual clothes in it, which she would not use for dinner parties. Su Tan searched for a long time but could not find any decent clothes.
Going out to buy? There is enough time, but the money...
Su Tan quickly checked her bank card online. Although there was some left over from the savings left by Su Tan's parents after their funeral, the Feng family never gave her living expenses. As a student, her daily expenses were not small. After two years of studying, the savings in several cards were only two thousand yuan. How could this little money be enough to buy a dress?
Su Tan thought of a countermeasure. She flipped through her phone. There were several friends from her original life. Su Tan picked one of her friends and called her. After hearing this, the other party sighed and said, "Young lady, how do I know where I can buy a dress? Why don't you go to a famous store?"
"Where is the famous store?"
“It’s near the Central Mall.”
Su Tan hung up the phone, sat on the sofa and sighed. It's really hard to find clothes today, so maybe don't go to the dinner! Otherwise, if you go there dressed too casually, you will onlyIt will be counterproductive.
Unexpectedly, as soon as Su Tan hung up the phone, a man came over and smiled:
"Miss Su, my name is Shangluca, and our president Feng asked me to send you to have your hair styled."
"What?" Su Tan was startled and looked up. Outside the floor-to-ceiling window, a black car had just left.
Did you hear her call? Or can she figure out her predicament without any guesswork?
Su Tan curled her lips and said nothing.
Ladies had to do their styling earlier. When Su Tan passed by, there were several ladies doing it. The man who opened the door was a well-dressed man who smelled of perfume. He looked a bit girly, but his words were very comfortable.
"Miss Su, my name is Shirley."
Su Tan greeted with a smile.
